notes: Domestic 2026-27: beIN SPORTS (pay) confirmed by the FFF for all 63 matches from the round of 32 to the final (2026-27 to 2029-30). No free-to-air broadcaster had been signed for 2026-27 as of 23 Oct 2026 (lot A, ex-France Televisions, still under negotiation), so no FTA entry is listed for France; if France Televisions renews, France 2/France 3/france.tv would again show one match per round plus the final, co-broadcast with beIN. International: no official FFF list of 2026-27 international broadcasters was found. Entries use the latest known holders: beIN's 2022-23 to 2025-26 international deal (30+ territories) and 2025-26 TV listings (LiveSoccerTV) for Portugal, Czech Republic, Lithuania, Albania and Cyprus - all flagged as not confirmed for 2026-27. Monaco, French overseas territories and Francophone Africa: no source found for Coupe de France coverage; not listed. Web search quota was exhausted during research, so further international checks (e.g. US, UK, Spain, Latin America, Sub-Saharan Africa) could not be completed.

broadcasters.note: beIN SPORTS holds lot B for 2026-27 to 2029-30: 63 matches = 100% of matches from the round of 32 (32es de finale) to the final, 53 exclusive and 10 co-broadcast with the lot A holder (FFF, 17 Dec 2025). Free-to-air lot A (one match per round + final, previously France Televisions on France 2 / France 3 / france.tv, through 2025-26) was STILL UNASSIGNED as of 22-23 Oct 2026: France Televisions wants to halve its fee and its CEO said the Coupe de France might not be renewed; TF1/TMC, M6/W9 and La Chaine L'Equipe were reported interested. Round of 32 is scheduled 19-20 Dec 2026. The 2026-27 competition began in summer 2026 (early amateur rounds).

beIN's international Coupe de France deal (announced Jan 2023) covered 'more than 30 territories' incl. 24 MENA countries, France, Australia, New Zealand, Turkey, Canada and Hong Kong 'until 2026' (2022-23 to 2025-26). 2026-27 international renewal not confirmed (beIN's Dec 2025 FFF renewal to 2030 is described for France/lot B only).
